title: KtulueKit Migration Configuration
description: Declarative configuration for restoring application state from a backup to a fresh Windows 11 install.

$schema.description: Path to the JSON schema for editor validation.

metadata.description: Project-level information about this migration config.

name.description: Display name of this migration configuration.

description.description: Brief description of what this config migrates.

backup_root.description: Root path to the backup location. Can use environment variables (%VAR%) or be an absolute path.

apps.description: Applications whose state should be migrated.

items.description: Individual file or directory copy operations for this app.

label.description: Short descriptive label for this copy operation.

source.description: Path relative to backup_root, or an absolute path. Supports %VAR% environment variables.

target.description: Destination path on the fresh install. Supports %VAR% environment variables.

strategy.description: Copy strategy. 'mirror' copies a full directory tree, 'file' copies a single file, 'glob' matches a pattern. Skateboard uses mirror only.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this item contains.

notes.description: Additional context or caveats about this copy operation.

profiles.description: Named presets that select subsets of items by their composite ID (AppName:label).

name.description: Display name for this profile preset.

ids.description: List of item IDs in 'AppName:label' format.
